annotation.title_clean: Iniciativa con proyecto de decreto por el que se expide la Ley Federal para el Desarrollo Ético, Soberano e Inclusivo de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Initiative with draft decree issuing the Federal Law for the Ethical, Sovereign and Inclusive Development of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Diputadas y diputados de MORENA y PVEM, Cámara de Diputados (LXVI Legislatura), México
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Mexican congressional bill (April 2025) proposing a comprehensive federal AI law with a four-tier traffic-light risk system, prohibited AI, a National AI Council, a national algorithmic audit platform, a national AI registry, strict liability for high-risk systems, child protections, sovereignty and sustainability provisions. No robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four-tier risk classification (minimal, limited, high, prohibited) with escalating obligations
Creates National AI Council and National Algorithmic Audit Platform (PNAA)
Mandatory registry (RENSIA) and algorithmic impact assessments for high-risk systems
Strict liability for high-risk AI and a Fund for Algorithmic Reparation
Bans on subliminal manipulation, coercive social scoring, mass biometric surveillance, black-box systems, and fully automated irreversible decisions
